title: Robust Stream Classification using Time Neutralising Decision Trees
abstract: arXiv:2611.06991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data Streams are characterised as a potentially infinite source of data subject to non-stationarity. This non-stationarity, also called Concept Drift, often results in deployed predictive models having to be perpetually retrained as the underlying data generating process of the stream changes over time. Drift Detectors are a class of methods used to identify these changes, triggering these retraining procedures. Historically, Stream Learning has operated under the assumption that instances are only seen once, and cannot be stored for later use. Contemporary work relaxes this assumption, yet drift detection and simple resetting procedures are still ubiquitous. translated_title: 使用时间中和决策树的鲁棒流分类
translated_abstract: 数据流的特点是一种可能无限的、且具有非平稳性的数据来源。这种非平稳性也被称为概念漂移，它常常导致已部署的预测模型不得不随着流底层数据生成过程随时间变化而被不断地重新训练。漂移检测器是一类用于识别这些变化的方法，用以触发这些重新训练过程。历史上，流学习一直运行在“实例只会被看到一次、无法存储以供后续使用”的假设之下。当代的工作放宽了这一假设，但漂移检测和简单的重置程序仍然无处不在。基于相关工作（其表明当实例可以被存储时，传统的批量学习算法往往优于流学习算法），我们提出了时间中和树（Time Neutralising Trees, TNT），这是一种决策树架构，能够在相关设置下实现鲁棒的流分类。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“时间中和树（TNT）”的决策树架构，通过中和时间因素的影响，在存在概念漂移且实例可被存储的数据流场景下实现鲁棒的流分类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Time Neutralising Trees (TNT), a Decision Tree architecture that neutralises temporal effects to enable robust stream classification in non-stationary data stream settings.
